definitions.explanation: Flour ground from buckwheat seeds. The primary ingredient for making soba noodles and galettes. Important in Japanese cuisine and relevant for allergy awareness.

examples.english: To make soba noodles from buckwheat flour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十割|じゅうわり}→十割：25145_juuwari⟧そば⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、そば{粉|こ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Juwari soba is made entirely from buckwheat flour.

examples.japanese: そば{粉|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、そば⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: I have a buckwheat allergy, so I need to be careful at soba restaurants.

notes:
Compound of そば (buckwheat; also written ⟦{蕎麦|そば}→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧) + {粉|こ} (flour; powder). Buckwheat flour is the essential ingredient for ⟦{蕎麦|そば}→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧ noodles, one of Japan's most iconic foods.

SOBA NOODLE RATIOS:
Soba noodles are classified by their buckwheat flour content:
- ⟦{十割|じゅうわり}→十割：25145_juuwari⟧そば: 100% buckwheat flour (no wheat)
- {八割|はちわり}そば ({二八|にはち}そば): 80% buckwheat, 20% wheat flour
- The higher the buckwheat ratio, the more fragrant but fragile the noodles

ALLERGY NOTE:
Buckwheat is one of Japan's designated allergens ({特定原材料|とくていげんざいりょう}). Buckwheat allergy can be severe, so products containing そば{粉|こ} must be labeled.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- そば{粉|こ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挽|ひ}く→挽く：12794_hiku⟧: to mill buckwheat
- そば{粉|こ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧: to knead buckwheat dough
- そば{粉|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ガレット: buckwheat galette (French crepe)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧: wheat flour — the most common flour in cooking
- ⟦{米粉|こめこ}→米粉：13771_komeko⟧: rice flour — used for rice noodles and sweets
